List available ITN parameterisations

Source: R/itn_params.R
list_ITN_params.Rd

Lists all net type / EHT combinations available in the built-in ITN_parameterisations_Champagne2025 dataset.

Every pair has both parameterisations (standard and dummy-host model), chosen with mode in get_ITN_params.

Usage

list_ITN_params()

Value

Data frame with columns netType, EHT and reference; netType and EHT are the net_type and EHT arguments of get_ITN_params.

Author

Clara Champagne, clara.champagne@swisstph.ch

Examples

list_ITN_params()
#>            netType         EHT                     reference
